turns.text: Thanks for calling Copper Wok Harbor, how can I help?
Hey, do you deliver to my area? I want the pad see ew and the mapo tofu and the shrimp fried rice.
Also, a friend of mine has a gluten allergy.
Thanks for telling me. Just to confirm, that's a gluten allergy for your friend?
Our allergen list doesn't show gluten in what you ordered. We do cook everything in one kitchen, so there is some risk of cross-contact.
Happy to. What address should we deliver to?
You're inside our delivery zone. That's pad see ew and mapo tofu and shrimp fried rice, $42.00 with the delivery fee. The driver should be there in about 50 minutes.
Can I get a name and phone number for the order?
